key_points: Q2 revenue rose 6% YoY to RMB15.7bn and earnings beat by ~9%
One‑time China antitrust penalty of ~RMB5bn drove a net loss but core profitability improved
Mobile bookings now exceed 70% of total, indicating strong consumer shift
Analyst sentiment mixed: JPM cut price target to $62 while TD Cowen upgraded to Strong‑Buy
Management highlighted international OTA growth and AI initiatives as future catalysts
